Name: Auto-Loot Fishing Chests
Author: JonathanFeenstra
Description:
[size=4][b]Auto-Loot Fishing Chests[/b][/size]
Automatically collect items from treasure chests caught while fishing if there is enough room in your inventory.

If there isn't enough room in your inventory to add all items from the chest, the chest's item grab menu will continue opening normally. Otherwise, it's automatically closed as soon as all its items have been added to your inventory.

[size=4][b]Comparison with mods that offer similar functionality[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/31662]Auto Treasure Collector[/url] has the same purpose as this mod and offers some customisable options that this mod doesn't, but has a bug where the items are lost when there is not enough space in your inventory.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25996]Glory Of Efficiency[/url]'s [url=https://github.com/Hackswell/GloryOfEfficiency/blob/develop/GloryOfEfficiency/FeaturesAndConfigs.md#auto-loot-treasures]Auto Loot Treasures feature[/url], which the aforementioned mod is based on, offers a setting to leave the menu open after all items have been collected. It also collects items from other sources, such as gifts. This mod is much smaller in scope.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5815]Fishing Assistant 2 (1.6 Compatible)[/url]'s [i]Auto Loot Treasure[/i] feature offers a setting to drop or discard items if your inventory is full. It checks if the treasure chest item grab menu is open [url=https://github.com/GhostUnderBlanket/Stardew-SMAPI-Mods/blob/025ef294063616c4bf92908c86c343a3f153cdcb/FishingAssistant2/ModEntry.cs#L134]every game tick[/url], whereas this mod only checks it when the menu changes.[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42793]Better Fishing (1.6 Compatibility)[/url]'s [i]Auto Obtain Treasure Chest[/i] feature only works if the [i]Skip Fishing Mini Game[/i] option is also enabled.[/*]
[/list]
